And it came with a fearmongering warning.

“803 days to Save America,” Miller wrote on X, apparently referring to Jan. 20, 2029, when the next U.S. president will be inaugurated.

The post came a day after Miller announced she was ending her podcast, “The Katie Miller Show,” following her husband Stephen Miller’s controversial promotion to White House chief of staff.

Stephen Miller, a leading architect of Trump’s hard-line anti-immigration agenda, replaces Susie Wiles in the wake of the GOP’s bruising losses in the 2026 midterm elections. His wife reportedly spent weeks lobbying Trump allies to help secure the promotion, per Politico.

Critics seized on Katie Miller’s post, reminding her of her admitted failure to vote in last week’s elections and suggesting America had already been saved thanks to the Republicans’ heavy midterm defeats.
